findings.body: This remains open from the previous review. These tests instantiate `ChatService` with fake dimension and period services; the fallback case bypasses Ask and calls `unsupportedFallbackMessage` directly. The frontend test likewise supplies a mocked response. No test drives the running API with a real database and then verifies in Playwright that definition, value, small-talk, and fallback suggestions are rendered and usable. Consequently regressions in Nest wiring, real latest-period discovery, HTTP/SSE serialization, or browser rendering/click behavior would pass this suite, contrary to the required end-to-end proof for user-facing behavior.
